# cloady_app (Resource)

Deploy a Git repository or catalog application. Creation records the application and starts deployment; status reports its observed state. Git source identity, region, environment, and workspace changes replace the application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploy a Git repository. Cloady detects the stack and builds it.
resource "cloady_app" "api" {
  workspace = cloady_workspace.acme.slug
  name      = "API"
  region    = "eu1"

  git = {
    repository_url = "https://github.com/acme/api"
    branch         = "main"
  }
}

# Or install a catalog application.
resource "cloady_app" "db" {
  workspace = cloady_workspace.acme.slug
  name      = "Postgres"
  region    = "eu1"
  catalog   = "postgres"

  # Volumes only ever grow. Lowering a size is rejected during planning.
  volume_sizes = { data = 20 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application display name. Changing it preserves the application slug.
- `region` (String) Deployment region ID.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) Catalog application name, such as postgres. Set exactly one of catalog or git.
- `cpu_scale` (Number) CPU multiplier, from 0.5 through 4 in increments of 0.25. This is not a core count.
- `environment` (String) Application environment: production, preview, or development.
- `git` (Attributes) Git source. Set exactly one of git or catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git))
- `memory_scale` (Number) Memory multiplier, from 0.5 through 4 in increments of 0.25. This is not a GiB amount.
- `slug` (String) Application slug. Generated from name when omitted. Changing a configured slug replaces the application.
- `volume_sizes` (Map of Number) Explicit volume size overrides in GiB, keyed by template volume name (1–4096 GiB). Existing volumes cannot shrink. Unspecified volumes retain their server-managed size.

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (List of String) Public endpoint URLs returned by Cloady.
- `id` (String) Import identifier: workspace/app/environment/region.
- `status` (String) Observed deployment state; successful apply does not imply readiness.

<a id="nestedatt--git"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git`

Required:

- `repository_url` (String) Repository URL, including its scheme, or git@ SSH address.

Optional:

- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Automatically deploy Git updates. Defaults to true; set false for manual deployments.
- `branch` (String) Git branch to deploy. Defaults to main, matching Cloady deployment behavior.
- `subdirectory` (String) Repository subdirectory without leading or trailing slashes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# workspace/app/environment/region
terraform import cloady_app.api acme/api/production/eu1
```
